rows.label: The brief
rows.text: Faith communities needed a digital home that wasn't a generic social feed. I set out to build one — alone.

rows.label: The work
rows.text: Designed the full brand system (palette, typography, voice), then built the product end-to-end: a mobile app, web client, and backend. Communities, events, prayer requests, an apologetics library, chat, and microblogs — shipped through the App Store as a solo founder.

rows.label: The result
rows.text: 1,000+ organic downloads with zero paid acquisition — growth driven entirely by brand, community, and content.

quote.text: Built for believers. No ads. No algorithms.

rows.label: The brief
rows.text: An early-stage AI startup with strong products and no marketing function. Build the brand — and the department — from a blank page.

rows.label: The work
rows.text: Own end-to-end brand and go-to-market across two product lines, reporting directly to the CEO. Built the messaging architecture, ICP personas, and a multi-page competitive positioning analysis from founder interviews, then translated it into a phased product launch — private beta through public release — with defined milestones and a community-led acquisition and partnership strategy running alongside it.

rows.label: The result
rows.text: A complete brand and go-to-market foundation, a structured launch plan tied to activation metrics instead of vanity ones, and the company's acceptance into a leading startup accelerator during my first week on the team. A routine technical audit also caught the site's own robots.txt blocking the exact AI crawlers the product was built to help clients rank with.

rows.label: The brief
rows.text: A global broadcast network serving a diaspora audience across languages and platforms — grow engagement and support.

rows.label: The work
rows.text: Led marketing 2019–2023 (rehired 2025): audience strategy, multilingual social content across platforms, paid media, and high-stakes donor relationships that funded the mission.

rows.label: The result
rows.text: 30% engagement increase, $25K+ in paid media managed, and email open rates grown from 23% to 41% across a 10,000+ subscriber donor communications program — plus major-donor conversations that taught me how to sell a vision one person at a time.
